title: Sir Roger Penrose & Dr. Stuart Hameroff: CONSCIOUSNESS AND THE PHYSICS OF THE BRAIN
summary: A 2020 UC San Diego event with Roger Penrose and Stuart Hameroff presenting their Orch OR theory that consciousness arises from quantum processes in brain microtubules, followed by a conversation with Roger Bingham.
why: HN commenters point to it as a presentation of the Penrose-Hameroff theory of consciousness, which some find compelling.

quote.text: for the first time I think a truly compelling idea of what consciousness is in a scientific way that could potentially be empirically measured.
